allowed_changes: on the first execution session of each calendar year, rank gold_cny, Nasdaq, S&P 500, CSI300 and Shanghai Composite by prior complete calendar-year CNY return
hold 100% of the single highest-return asset for the new calendar year only when its prior-year return is strictly positive
hold CashYieldCNY for the entire new year when no candidate has a positive prior-year return
one annually rebalanced 20% each five-asset control and one cash control
use the product-level 1.00% fee and 0.05% slippage assumptions with no sensitivity grid
comparison_gates: CAGR > annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
Sharpe > annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
MDD <= annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
expected_outputs: annual-winner, annual-equal and CNY-cash portfolio CSVs
actual trade count, average cash, realized max gross, minimum cash, target fingerprint and owner-by-year audit
global post-protocol DSR after the formal run
run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance metric is viewed, do not change lookback, decision cadence, asset universe, number of winners, weighting, positive-return cash gate, fee/slippage or add a confirmation filter in this lineage. A different momentum horizon or multi-winner rule is a separate preregistered lineage, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: monthly, quarterly or semiannual rebalance rescue
top-2/top-3 portfolios, inverse-volatility sizing, risk parity or volatility targets
changing or dropping any of the five asset roles after results
changing the product fee/slippage after viewing results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash
hypothesis: Cross-asset leadership often persists across slow macro and capital-flow regimes. Allocating the full unlevered portfolio for one calendar year to the single asset with the strongest positive CNY return over the immediately preceding complete calendar year should capture that persistence while keeping turnover and product-level trading costs very low. If every candidate asset was negative in the prior year, holding CNY demand cash for the next year avoids forcing risk exposure.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
selection_metric: No parameter or within-family selection. One prior-complete-calendar-year winner, one owner, one annual decision. Validation, objective attainment and annual-equal comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.rebalance: first execution session of each new calendar year only
